statement: 论文摘要报告，PRM、RRT 等采样规划方法在实践中表现良好，并具有概率完备性等理论保证。
quote: sampling-based path planning algorithms, such as Probabilistic RoadMaps (PRM) and Rapidly-exploring Random Trees (RRT), have been shown to work well in practice and possess theoretical guarantees such as probabilistic completeness

statement: 论文证明：在温和技术条件下，广泛使用的采样规划算法返回解的代价几乎必然收敛到非最优值。
quote: under mild technical conditions, the cost of the solution returned by broadly used sampling-based algorithms converges almost surely to a non-optimal value

statement: RRT* 与 PRM* 是可证明渐近最优的采样规划算法，且计算复杂度与原版相比只差常数因子。
quote: The main contribution of the paper is the introduction of new algorithms, namely, PRM* and RRT*, which are provably asymptotically optimal, i.e., such that the cost of the returned solution converges almost surely to the optimum. Moreover, it is shown that the computational complexity of the new algorithms is within a constant factor of that of their probabilistically complete (but not asymptotically optimal) counterparts.

statement: 梯度轨迹优化广泛用于四旋翼轨迹重规划，但存在局部极小值问题，对安全性和平滑导航都不利。
quote: Gradient-based trajectory optimization (GTO) has gained wide popularity for quadrotor trajectory replanning. However, it suffers from local minima, which is not only fatal to safety but also unfavorable for smooth navigation

statement: 作者提出路径引导优化（PGO）来处理不可行局部极小，并报告重规划成功率有所提升。
quote: A path-guided optimization (PGO) approach is devised to tackle infeasible local minima, which improves the replanning success rate significantly

statement: 拓扑路径搜索可捕获 3D 环境中一组独特的有用路径，每条路径独立引导一次轨迹优化，从而更全面探索解空间。
quote: A topological path searching algorithm is developed to capture a collection of distinct useful paths in 3-D environments, each of which then guides an independent trajectory optimization. It activates a more comprehensive exploration of the solution space and output superior replanned trajectories.

statement: RAPTOR 的背景分析指出，在有限计算时间下，当时的快速导航方法对解的可行性与质量缺乏强保证。
quote: high-speed navigation still remains a significant challenge. Given very limited time, existing methods have no strong guarantee on the feasibility or quality of the solutions

statement: RAPTOR 作者将环境感知视为快速飞行的关键瓶颈，并指出当时多数规划方法未考虑这一因素。
quote: most methods do not consider environment perception, which is the key bottleneck to fast flight

statement: RAPTOR 引入感知驱动规划策略主动观察并避开未知障碍，并通过风险感知轨迹细化使威胁性未知障碍更早被发现、及时避开。
quote: We also introduce a perception-aware planning strategy to actively observe and avoid unknown obstacles. A risk-aware trajectory refinement ensures that unknown obstacles which may endanger the quadrotor can be observed earlier and avoid in time.

statement: 梯度规划器中，欧氏符号距离场（ESDF）对评估梯度大小和方向至关重要，但计算 ESDF 存在大量冗余。
quote: a Euclidean Signed Distance Field (ESDF) is crucial for evaluating gradient magnitude and direction. Nevertheless, computing such a field has much redundancy since the trajectory optimization procedure only covers a very limited subspace of the ESDF updating range.

statement: EGO-Planner 作者提出 ESDF-free 梯度规划框架，并报告计算时间有所减少。
quote: an ESDF-free gradient-based planning framework is proposed, which significantly reduces computation time

statement: EGO-Planner 将惩罚函数中的碰撞项表述为碰撞轨迹与无碰撞引导路径的比较，使规划器只提取必要的障碍信息。
quote: The main improvement is that the collision term in the penalty function is formulated by comparing the colliding trajectory with a collision-free guiding path. The resulting obstacle information will be stored only if the trajectory hits new obstacles, making the planner only extract necessary obstacle information.

statement: EGO-Planner 的源代码以 ROS 包形式开源发布。
quote: The source code is released as ROS packages

statement: 随着机器人应用场景复杂性与随机性增加，经典分层运动规划器的规划能力受到挑战。
quote: As the complexity and randomness of robot application scenarios increase, the planning capability of the classical hierarchical motion planners is challenged

statement: 该综述将无模型、不依赖先验结构化地图以及统一全局与局部规划，概括为所讨论 DRL 规划方法的特点。
quote: DRL-based motion planner is model-free and does not rely on the prior structured map. Most importantly, DRL-based motion planner achieves the unification of the global planner and the local planner

statement: 该综述总结了经典运动规划架构各子模块的代表性与最新工作，并分析其性能特征。
quote: we summarize the representative and state-of-the-art works for each submodule of the classical motion planning architecture and analyze their performance features
